A '''Silver Trophy Frog Sack''' is a {{Rare}} [[Sack]] that holds {{Green|512}} of each {{Gray|Silver}} [[Trophy Frog]]. 

== Obtaining ==
A '''Silver Trophy Frog Sack''' can be obtained as a reward for reaching [[Researcher Ribery#Adept Frog Collector|Adept Frog Collector]]. If lost, it can be bought from {{NPCSprite|Researcher Ribery}} for {{c|100k}} after reaching the milestone.

== Usage ==
The '''Silver Trophy Frog Sack''' can store {{Gray|Silver}} [[Trophy Frog]]s.
